sources.text: HOME admin 2024-02-23T12:24:29-07:00 Understanding novel materials functions from molecular aspects by nonlinear optics. The Xiong lab currently has four postdoctoral fellows and thirteen graduate students. Seven Ph.D. alumni have entered industry (Intel, Applied Materials, etc) and academic (postdocs). We are currently funded by NSF, NIH, AFOSR, DOE and Sloan Research Foundation. Learn more > We are actively hiring !
